entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I... I need to make a return. I bought a helmet and I'm just so disappointed about it.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh no, there's nothing wrong with it. It’s just... the color. It looked so different on the website. I’ve been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but it just doesn't match anything. I really needed that money back for other things. The box unopened, still sealed and everything.

I completely understand. Getting the look and feel of your gear just right is important. Let me pull up your order. I see you purchased the Aero Road Helmet, and it was delivered 31 days ago. Let me just quickly review the policy for this item.
Okay... I was just hoping it wasn't too late.

Not at all. I've just confirmed, and you're well within our 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, we can absolutely process a full refund for you. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied and feel good about the safety and style of your gear.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you, thank you so much, David. I was so worried I was just stuck with it. You've made my day.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help sort this out for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. Just attach that to the box and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. I'll do that this afternoon. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
